rules.lte: Numeric offered value must be <= required maximum.
rules.gte: Numeric offered capability/limit must be >= requested minimum.
rules.eq: Exact scalar match; unknown is unresolved.
rules.contains: Collection contains requested language/capability or a numeric range includes requested value. Do not stringify and substring-match.

normalization.water_protection: Derive supported exposure categories only with a qualified rating source: IP67/IP68 support immersion and splash claims; IPX7 supports water immersion/splash but says nothing about dust. Preserve evidence qualification; no empirical guarantee.
normalization.color_temperature_k: Represent offered fixed values or documented supported range, not prose.
normalization.battery_hours_up_to: Maximum advertised runtime is not guaranteed runtime at the customer’s volume; retain test conditions and treat sufficient real-world endurance as unresolved where conditions differ.
normalization.laptop_inches: Diagonal claim alone does not establish fit. Compare actual device and compartment dimensions when available; otherwise unresolved fit caveat.
normalization.brightness_levels: For continuous dimming, record dimming_mode=continuous; do not invent a count to compare numerically. Mark functional requirement met only with a documented normalization rule.
normalization.reviews_per_month: Represent explicitly unlimited allowances as unlimited, never an invented large integer.
normalization.turnaround_hours: For immediate interactive tools, latency may remain unknown; do not invent a delivery SLA.
normalization.word_limit: Use documented maximum if available; an unknown limit is not unlimited.
normalization.documents_needed: Compute whole evaluation-scope cost before comparing price. An annual plan must fit full upfront budget; no imaginary monthly purchasing option.

status: Contract mapping guidance; runtime normalization/enforcement not implemented.
